titel: Why your tape measure hook is loose

saetze.text: Why is the hook on your tape measure loose?
It moves exactly its own thickness, not a hair more.
Hook it on a board and pull, it slides out,
and zero sits right where it touches the board.
But push it against a wall, it slides in,
and zero sits right where it touches the wall.
So however you measure, its thickness never sneaks into the reading.
Squeeze it tight, and one of the two will always come out wrong.
So yes, it's loose, but on purpose.
Send this to that friend who squeezed their tape measure hook thinking it was broken.
